newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse's turnover more than tripled in H1.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse's turnover more than tripled in H1.

text.p: Turnover on the Athens bourse's main market more than tripled year-on-year in the first half of 1997, said Ionian Research in its monthly report.
Customer business in main market listings during the first half of 1997 rose 270 percent to 2,836 billion drachmas from 767 billion drachmas in the respective period of 1996, it said.
Total main market turnover in 1996 was 1,818 billion drachmas.
Average main market daily turnover in the 120 sessions to June 30 exceeded 23.6 billion drachmas.
Marketability of main market listings stood at 33.1 percent, the report said.

Between January 1 and June 30, the bourse placed the welcome mat for three main market listings and five small-caps in its parallel market, which raised a total of 14.26 billion drachmas. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
